rules: Use controls applicable to the exact hypotheses; no mandatory unrelated exhaustive suite.
A failed helper and FEI itself have different quantifiers.
Read original sources before relying on the navigation summary.

controls.title: Addressing calibration
controls.exact_scope: H=2a and I=1+a/2; a complete-set code should not pay the same address label independently for every coordinate.

controls.title: Sparse activated bent point surgery
controls.exact_scope: For d=2^(-3k), L/d=k+log2(e)+o(1), V_post/d<=4*2^(-k), M_inf/d=12k*2^(-3k). Refutes the fixed-price all-coordinate local helper only.

controls.title: Selector erasure synergy
controls.exact_scope: A one-bit actual selector can have entropy increment divided by selector influence tending to infinity. Preserve the data and terminal contribution.

controls.title: Fixed spectral Renyi below one
controls.exact_scope: The actual point-defect family has H_alpha/I->infinity for every fixed 0<alpha<1, while Shannon H/I->4. Does not refute scale-dependent orders or auxiliary piece Renyi quantities.

controls.title: Already proved positive selector-energy closure
controls.exact_scope: Fresh uniform selectors with I_sel>=c*a close ordinary FEI at max{2/c,C}; this is baseline, not a new target. New work must derive c for a new unbounded class or handle low energy/reused selectors.

controls.title: Arbitrarily rare activated cores
controls.exact_scope: Rarity by itself can retain full-FEI difficulty. State the exact ratio-preserving embedding before calling a restricted endpoint easier.

controls.title: Sparse activation does not preserve STEP criticality
controls.exact_scope: Along the complete B01/A005 A002 hardness sequence, every fresh activation control has Delta_zH/I_z -> 4 independently of the seed. This refutes STEP preservation by that embedding, not universal STEP or FEI.

controls.title: Critical sources require all-coordinate step dominance
controls.exact_scope: If Delta_iH/I_i(f)<H(f)/I(f), an actual physical child has larger ratio. Hence descendant-critical sources satisfy Delta_iH>=R(f)I_i(f) for every relevant coordinate. This is necessary, not a universal upper bound.

controls.title: Critical tree slack is globally signed, not nodewise nonnegative
controls.exact_scope: For a descendant-critical root, reach-weighted fixed-root slacks sum to the nonnegative terminal fixed-root deficit on every stopped physical tree. Individual descendant slacks may be negative, and a complete tree has total signed slack exactly zero. This obstructs summing local nonnegative refunds; it does not refute compensated global trees.
